<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/exceptions/{caseId}/resolutions"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Records the resolution code and the root cause and moves the case to
`RESOLVED`, its terminal state. `note` is optional. Resolving an
already-resolved case is a 409 `case-already-resolved`; any later
command on it is too. Requires an `Idempotency-Key`. Publishes
`ExceptionResolved`.
